kept for history but not offered for new use
Behaviour for Inactive patients or doctors is not addressed by the ticket.
Given more than 20 patients, when staff open the patient list, then each page shows 20 patients.
The patient list still shows 20 patients per page.

findings.suggested_fix: Reword it, e.g. 'every page except the last shows 20 patients, and the last shows the rest', or check only the first page.
findings.text: S-4 AC1 says each page shows 20 patients whenever there are more than 20. A correct build with, for example, 25 patients has a last page of 5, so this criterion would fail a correct implementation.

cites.quote: earliest appointment with status Scheduled whose start is after the current time
Given a patient with more than one Scheduled appointment starting after the current time

findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC for a patient whose only Scheduled appointment started in the past: the column shows "None" (or the next future one).
findings.text: REQ-2 requires the start to be after the current time, but no AC checks that a Scheduled appointment whose start has already passed is left out. AC2 only compares upcoming appointments with each other.

cites.quote: Given a search that staff could run before this change
Given a search that worked before this change

findings.suggested_fix: Use the same wording in both places.
findings.text: S-4 AC2 is worded differently in the frontmatter ('could run before') and the body ('worked before'). The two wordings could be read as different preconditions.
S-1 traces five requirements. It could be split (e.g. selection and exclusion apart from display fields) to keep one outcome per story, though one combined column story is defensible.

rubric_items.reason: All known REQ-1 to REQ-11 and assumed REQ-12 are traced by exactly one story each.
Most stories have one outcome. S-1 bundles five REQs (column, selection, time, doctor, exclusion), but they serve one visible outcome.
All criteria use Given/When/Then. S-4 AC1 fails on a valid last page, and no AC checks that past Scheduled appointments are excluded.
The values 20, Asia/Kolkata, None and the medical-history fields all come from the intent or the glossary it cites.
Clear and consistent overall. S-4 AC2 wording differs slightly between the frontmatter and the body.
